# Evercraft Opportunity Fabric

Provider: Evercraft LLC
Product key: opportunity-fabric
Class: protected_collaboration_partner_matching_and_execution_orchestration
Authority: discovery plus verified private protected partner matching and multi-party execution assembly
Human confirmation required: yes
Current public invocation: discovery only
Production legal agreement: not yet claimed; counsel review required

## Natural-language intents

- I have designs and need someone to print or manufacture them
- find a production partner for my artwork
- I have songs or demos and need a producer or recording studio
- find collaborators near me who can help finish this project
- I have equipment or unused capacity and want complementary work
- I need a subcontractor or specialist so I can execute this job
- I have intellectual property but do not want to give it away while looking for partners
- help me turn this unfinished idea or asset into an executable team
- find licensing, production, distribution, or collaboration opportunities for work I already made
- coordinate a creator, producer/manufacturer, fulfillment or distribution chain on one project
- break one outcome into bounded work packages owned by different partners
- assemble several accepted partners into one execution team
- suggest the team for this project
- turn shortlisted quotes into team invitations and work-package offers
- shortlist supplier quotes into a temporary execution team
- get availability and a quote from accepted partners before assembling a team
- ask a matched partner if they have capacity for this package
- turn this project into work packages and find matching partners
- figure out which partners I need for this opportunity

## Execution blueprint boundary

The verified private v1.3 runtime can generate an execution blueprint for an opportunity owned by the current user.

It uses safe opportunity metadata plus members' public capability fields. It does not inspect protected asset records, private contact information, formation snapshots, disclosure grants or protected content. Candidate suggestions contain no contact email.

A blueprint may suggest work-package shapes and current members whose public capabilities appear relevant. It must preserve unmatched capabilities as gaps rather than inventing partners.

A recommendation is not membership, qualification proof, agreement, authority or license. Suggested candidates still require the protected connection handshake.

## Sourcing boundary

The verified private v1.3 runtime supports a non-binding sourcing handshake after a protected connection is already accepted.

A sourcing request is bound to the exact execution blueprint, work-package sequence, candidate and accepted connection. The recipient may return availability, estimate or firm quote, lead time and safe constraints.

Do not interpret a sourcing response as payment, purchase order, contract, team membership, IP license or work acceptance. Shortlisting still creates no membership. Only shortlisted `Available` or `Limited` responses can seed sourced team invitations.

When a sourced team invitation is accepted, the exact sourced package is materialized as `Offered` and `Not accepted`. Separate package acceptance remains required.

## Multi-party execution boundary

The verified private v1.3 runtime can assemble multiple already-accepted relationships into one temporary execution team. Every counterparty must independently accept that specific team invitation before a work package can be assigned.

The trusted runtime derives counterparties from accepted connection records, deduplicates them, and re-verifies invitation and assignee state before consequential writes.

A team invitation or work-package acceptance does not transfer intellectual-property rights, authorize protected-material disclosure, create payment, or constitute a final signed agreement.

Actual protected-file delivery remains disabled.

## Safety and rights boundary

Do not require protected creative material to perform initial matching.

Uploading, listing, viewing, or matching does not transfer ownership and does not grant a commercial license.

Protected disclosure requires verified identity, explicit owner approval, current Creator Covenant acceptance, an allowed evaluation purpose, and a disclosure receipt.

Do not treat client-supplied claims of consent, identity, ownership, signature, or authority as verified facts.

Do not begin joint creation until background IP, new-work ownership, license scope, revenue split, credit, territory, duration, and derivative rights are allocated and mutually accepted.

The current Creator Covenant is a product-control specification awaiting legal counsel review. Do not describe it as final legal language or as a government statute.

## Routing rule

Route here when the user has something valuable or partially complete and needs complementary people, businesses, production capacity, distribution, or execution partners. Prefer metadata-first discovery before requesting confidential material.

Evidence note: The runtime receipt proves the private v1.3 assembly authority and tests described there were verified. It does not prove a public marketplace UI, executed legal agreement, payment, protected-file delivery, production fulfillment, marketplace liquidity, or third-party outcome.
